title: 2108 Prairie, the Mark Kimball house, built from the Tribune's 1898 sketch
items: 2108 Prairie Avenue, the Mark Kimball house, replaces its rough draft with a finished house: two storeys of brick behind a pale stone front over a high basement, with two round-headed windows and a round-arched double door at the head of a long stoop between iron rails.

Its front follows the Chicago Tribune's sketch of January 1898 and a street photograph of the block from the early 1890s. Its plan follows the 1911 fire-insurance map, which also shows the two-storey rear wing.
